summary: @servicetitan/ko-bridge ships preinstall dropper that downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated 727KB payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases (bun-v1.3.13), extracts and chmod+x's the bun binary into a temp directory, and then execFileSyncs it against a sibling file math_init.js shipped at the tarball root. math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-compiled CJS bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) with obfuscator-style string-array rotation and a >1000-entry constant table; it is not referenced from dist/ or src/ and is unrelated to the package's advertised Knockout/React bridge purpose. On `npm install`, the preinstall hook runs the opaque payload under an alien runtime that bypasses Node-based inspection, giving arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine. The mismatch between the advertised library purpose (pure JS KO/React glue) and the shipped install-time behavior (alternate-runtime execution of a large obfuscated bundle) is the canonical alternate-runtime-dropper shape.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
